HLP Innovations Private Limited is hiring **Partner Onboarding Executives** for **CuraX**, a healthcare technology platform built for clinics, diagnostic centres, and hospitals.

CuraX helps healthcare providers improve their digital presence, showcase services and pricing, manage bookings, receive patient enquiries, use QR\-based check\-in, and improve the overall patient experience through the CuraX Partner platform.

We are looking for energetic, confident, and target\-driven field executives who can visit clinics, hospitals, and diagnostic centres, explain CuraX clearly, collect required onboarding details, and help healthcare partners go live on the platform.

This is a field\-heavy role. Candidates must be comfortable travelling locally, meeting doctors, clinic owners, diagnostic centre managers, hospital administrators, and front desk teams.

* Visit clinics, diagnostic centres, hospitals, and healthcare facilities in assigned areas.

* Help partners complete registration and onboarding forms.
* Coordinate with the internal verification team to get partner profiles reviewed and approved.
* Place QR code standees, posters, stickers, or onboarding material at partner locations whenever required.
* Train clinic, diagnostic, or hospital staff on basic usage of the CuraX Partner platform.
* Maintain daily visit reports, lead status, follow\-ups, and conversion updates.

* Must be comfortable meeting doctors, clinic owners, diagnostic centre managers, and hospital staff.
* Should be able to maintain daily reports and follow\-up records properly.
* Healthcare, pharma, diagnostics, insurance, fintech, POS, merchant onboarding, or SaaS sales experience is an added advantage.

**Preferred Skills**

Field sales experience.

Healthcare or medical sales experience.

Ability to convince and build trust with business owners.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team in Bangalore. As an engineer, you will help design, build, and operate core messaging and caching services that our product teams rely on to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable experiences to customers worldwide. You will work with senior engineers and managers to implement platform features, improve reliability and performance, and build tooling and libraries that make it easy for product teams to adopt best‑practice eventing and caching patterns.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to a Senior Engineering Manager in Cloud \& Production Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, implement, and test features in our events, cache, and queues platform, under the guidance of senior engineers
* Contribute to internal client libraries and SDKs that standardize how Docusign services interact with Azure Service Bus, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka, Redis, and related platforms
* Help improve the reliability and performance of messaging and caching systems by implementing metrics, logging, and tracing for critical paths, participating in root‑cause analysis (RCA) discussions and follow‑up fixes, and automating runbooks and operational tasks where possible
* Collaborate with teammates to review designs and code, share feedback, and learn best practices for distributed systems and event‑driven architectures
* Write unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure high quality and maintainability of code
* Work with SRE and partner engineering teams to roll out changes safely, including canary deployments, feature flags, and configuration management
* Learn and follow secure coding practices, including proper handling of secrets, credentials, and access to messaging and cache resources
* Participate in team rituals (standups, planning, retrospectives) and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a BE/BTech, ME/MTech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and problem solving
* Programming experience in at least one object‑oriented or systems language such as Java, C\#, Python or Go
* Familiarity with basic concepts in distributed systems (for example, client‑server, latency, throughput, retries) and networking (for example, HTTP, TCP/IP)
* Comfort with Linux or another UNIX‑like operating system and command‑line tools
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment


**Preferred**
* Internship or project experience building backend services, microservices, or APIs
* Exposure to messaging or streaming systems (for example, Azure Service Bus, Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ) or caching systems (for example, Redis, Memcached), through coursework, projects, or internships
* Experience with either Cloud platforms such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, or Containers (Docker) and basic CI/CD tooling, or writing automated tests and using version control (Git)
* Demonstrated interest in reliability and performance (for example, course projects, hackathons, or personal projects related to distributed systems or infrastructure)
* A growth mindset and eagerness to learn from feedback, mentors, and teammates


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. About T4Tech Vision Pvt. Ltd.

T4Tech Vision Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing system integrator delivering end\-to\-end Audio\-Visual (AV) and IT infrastructure solutions to corporate, education, hospitality, and government clients across India. As we scale our operations, we are looking for a driven Senior HR Executive to strengthen our people function and help build a high\-performance culture.

Role Overview:

***Looking for someone who is ambitious, takes ownership, and want to learn and grow with the company.***

The Senior HR Executive will be a key contributor to our HR function, handling three critical pillars: Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition, Generalist HR Operations, and Payroll \& Compliance. You will work closely with department heads to attract top talent, ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR operations, and maintain full statutory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Experience and hiring sales people.
* Develop and post compelling job descriptions across job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed) and social media.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for technical (AV/IT/Hardware) and non\-technical roles.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements and create job profiles.
* Negotiate and extend offer letters; manage pre\-joining formalities and documentation.
* Drive campus hiring and referral programs to reduce time\-to\-hire.
* Track and report recruitment metrics: TAT, offer\-to\-joining ratio, cost\-per\-hire.

2\. Generalist HR Operations

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRMS system.
* Manage the employee lifecycle: confirmation, transfers, promotions, separations, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting, and feedback documentation.
* Implement and communicate HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs.
* Organize employee engagement initiatives, team events, and R\&R (Rewards \& Recognition) programs.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and escalate complex issues to management.

3\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Process monthly payroll accurately and ensure timely salary disbursement in coordination with Finance.
* Manage statutory compliance: PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, Gratuity, and Bonus as per applicable laws.
* Prepare and file returns for PF, ESIC, and PT with relevant government portals.
* Maintain compliance registers and records as required under the Shops \& Establishments Act, Labour Laws, and other applicable regulations.
* Issue salary slips, Form 16, experience letters, and other employment documentation.
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws and ensure timely policy updates.

Qualifications \& SkillsEducation

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources (preferred) or Bachelor's degree in any discipline with relevant HR experience.

Experience

* 3–5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in a technology, system integrator, or services company.
* Proven track record in handling recruitment for technical profiles (Engineers, AV/IT Specialists).
* Hands\-on experience with payroll processing and statutory compliance.

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in HRMS/HRIS platforms (e.g., GreytHR, Keka, Zoho People, or similar).
* Working knowledge of payroll software and government compliance portals (EPFO, ESIC, MCA).
* Proficient in MS Office Suite: Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), Word, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with job portals: Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Shine.

Soft Skills

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal).
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work under deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary package commensurate with experience.
* A dynamic, collaborative, and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to build and shape the HR function in a growing organization.
* Exposure to diverse hiring across technical, AV, and business functions.
* Professional development and upskilling support.

* Internet reimbursement

title: Outbound Sales Representative
description:
**About Us:**

Welcome to WisdmLabs, where fresh minds meet experienced mentors! We are a dynamic web agency that believes in nurturing talent from day one. If you're a recent graduate excited about web development and curious about AI tools (don't worry, we'll teach you!), this is your perfect starting point. Join our supportive team environment where learning is encouraged, mistakes are part of growth, and your potential is our priority.

**Position Summary:**

We're looking for someone who genuinely wants to hit the ground running \- not shadow someone, not fill a spreadsheet, but actively contribute to how we grow. In this role, you'll speak with real prospects, run outbound campaigns, and create content that has a clear job: start conversations, earn attention, and bring the right people closer to us. You'll be working with AI as an active part of your workflow \- using it to research, draft, personalise, and move faster without losing quality. You'll get a firsthand sense of how pipelines get built, what makes people respond, and how marketing and outreach come together to move a business forward. You'll have full ownership of what you work on \- and a team that's always up for a brainstorm or to help you think through a jam. If you get excited about crafting a cold email that actually gets a reply, or figuring out why a LinkedIn post pulled in 10x the usual reach, this role is for you.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Research and build targeted prospect lists across industries, personas, and segments relevant to our ideal customer profile
* Write, send, iterate, and analyse outbound sequences \- cold emails and LinkedIn DMs \- tracking open rates, reply rates, and meetings booked
* Own social media execution across LinkedIn and Instagram \- posts, carousels, short\-form content that attract and warm up the right audience. We'll also experiment with faceless AI\-first video accounts
* Turn customer wins, product updates, free tools, and internal inputs into outreach hooks, social proof assets, and content \- things that give prospects a genuine reason to engage
* Use AI tools actively \- for prospecting, personalising outreach, drafting copy, and improving messaging

**What we're looking for:**

* Strong written communication \- clarity, intent, and a sense of who you're writing for
* A genuine curiosity about people \- what drives them, what frustrates them, what they actually want
* A bias toward figuring things out on your own first \- you'll ask Google or AI before you ask a person
* Comfort with AI tools, or a strong eagerness to get there fast
* Organised and consistent \- you can manage a list, follow up, and track what's working

**Who will do well in this role:**

* You find human behaviour genuinely interesting \- and that curiosity shows up in how you write and who you write to
* You pay attention to the marketing you experience as a user \- what made you open, stop, or respond \- and you think about why
* You were active in college clubs, fests, or student initiatives, and you bring that same energy to your work
* You hit a wall and find a way around it before asking someone to move it

**Why join us:**

* You'll be doing real work from day one \- outreach, content, campaigns \- not busywork
* You'll get direct access to prospects and clients, which is rare this early in a career
* You'll learn how outbound and social work together in practice, not in theory
* You'll build a body of work \- campaigns, sequences, content \- that you can actually point to
* You'll be part of a small team that takes your ideas seriously

**What we offer:** 

* **Internship (6 months):** INR 15,000/month plus mentorship support
* **After You Wow Us:** ₹4,00,000 per annum based on skills demonstrated.
* Annual performance reviews with growth\-based salary increases
* **Additional benefits:** Health insurance, learning budget, flexible work hours.

As a human resources (HR) intern at SaveIN, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various HR functions while working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment. Your proficiency in English, both spoken and written, will be a valuable asset as you assist in recruitment, talent management, and other HR tasks.

* Assist in onboarding new employees by preparing paperwork, conducting orientation sessions, and ensuring a smooth transition into the company.
* Maintain employee records and ensure compliance with HR policies and procedures.
* Provide administrative support to the HR department as needed.


 About Company: SaveIN is a new\-age financial technology platform that aims to revolutionize how Indians access credit, banking, and personal finance products. We aim to build novel financial products and experiences in a 100% digital, paperless, and mobile\-first ecosystem. We are backed by Silicon Valley technology investor Y Combinator and have recently launched India's simplest healthcare financing solution, 'Care Now Pay Later'.

title: HR Intern (Paid)
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a motivated HR Intern to join our People team at 5paisa Capital's Thane office. This is a dual\-function role covering both Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partnering, offering well\-rounded exposure to core HR functions in a listed BFSI organization.
 



  





**Talent Acquisition Responsibilities** 



* Source candidates via job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn) and social channels
* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic interviews
* Coordinate interview scheduling with hiring managers
* Maintain and update the applicant tracking sheet
* Draft and publish job postings across platforms
* Assist with offer rollouts and pre\-joining follow\-ups
* Track hiring TATs and share weekly MIS reports



  





**HRBP Responsibilities** 



* Support employee onboarding and induction processes
* Assist in HR documentation — offer letters, confirmations, NDAs
* Handle employee queries and escalate where required
* Support exit formalities and separation paperwork
* Help with engagement initiatives and pulse surveys
* Maintain employee records and HRMS data hygiene
* Assist in preparing HR decks and dashboards for reviews



  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Familiarity with job portals and sourcing tools
* High ownership mindset with willingness to handle both TA and HRBP work
* Prior HR internship experience preferred but not mandatory
* Interest in the BFSI / FinTech sector is a plus



  





**What You'll Gain** 



* End\-to\-end recruitment exposure in a high\-volume environment
* HRBP operations experience in a listed financial services company
* Mentorship from senior HR professionals
* Certificate of internship completion
* Real project ownership, not just administrative support



  





**Conversion Opportunity** 




 High\-performing interns will be considered for a full\-time role at the end of the internship period. This is a genuine opportunity to build a career at 5paisa Capital.
 



  





**Duration:** 
 6 months
 **Stipend:** 
 Up to ₹25,000 per month
 **Location:** 
 Bengaluru

description:
Overview:

Job Role: Media Planning \- Sr Analyst


YOE: 3 \- 5 Relevant Years of Experience


Skills: End\-to\-end digital campaign planning


Open Locations: Pune \& Mohali


Shift: US Shift


Job Type: Full\-time \| Hybrid

 **Join us at OGS**  

We are OGS—Omnicom's Integrated Solutions Engine that brings together a global talent community and connected capabilities in data, creative, media, commerce, and technology to build adaptive, future\-ready solutions.  

We are redefining the global capability center \- not as an offshoring hub, but as a true inside edge. OGS is the place where the future is tested, built, and scaled for the world’s most ambitious agencies and clients.  

**With over 7000\+ talented professionals in India**, we are proud to be a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative community that thrives on innovation and excellence. Our teams work with some of the world’s most iconic brands, helping them move faster and achieve more—everywhere. We are growing rapidly and looking for passionate individuals to be part of this journey.  

Let us build this, together!


Responsibilities:

This role of Sr Analyst – Media Planning supports the **development and execution of media campaigns for global brands across all channels**. As part of a centralized team, you will work closely with planners, buyers, and cross\-functional teams in onshore markets to support the planning, documentation, and execution of media campaigns.  

Your expertise of ad tech and knowledge of the Digital Ecosystem would make you a great fit for this position. This is a great opportunity to work closely with the Top Global brands and own large and reputed accounts. Need to support Global clients and account Managers of our Media Solutions team and capable of:

* Supporting the **development of digital media plans by analyzing client briefs**, audience insights, competitive activity and category trends.
* Assist planners and managers in preparing media plans, presentations, and planning documentation including budgets, flowcharts, and planning spreadsheets.
* Gather and analyze data from syndicated research and planning tools such as GWI, ComScore, Nielsen, or other industry sources to inform planning decisions.
* Maintain and update media planning documentation, ensuring accuracy of data entry, taxonomy coding, and campaign details.
* Collaborate with internal teams including activation, Ad Operations, analytics, and account teams to support campaign execution.
* Monitor campaign pacing and performance against key metrics such as impressions, CTR, engagement, and conversions, highlighting optimization opportunities.
* Prepare campaign reports, summaries, and insights to support internal discussions and client reporting.
* Participate in internal meetings and planning discussions, providing research insights, documentation support, and follow\-ups.


Qualifications:
* A full\-time graduate degree
* **3 – 5 years of experience in media planning** across channels, marketing analytics or campaign operations (agency experience preferred)
* Basic understanding of marketing channels such as TV, OOH, Print, Radio, along with **expertise in Digital media planning.**
* Familiarity with media planning tools and syndicated research platforms such as GWI, ComScore, Vivvix, Prisma and Mbox.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail with the ability to work with large datasets
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


This may be the right role for you if you have:

* The ability to work effectively as part of a team and manage your time efficiently
* A strong interest in media, advertising, and digital marketing
* The ability to analyse data and translate insights into planning recommendations
* A positive attitude toward problem\-solving, networking, and being resourceful—eager to learn and unafraid to ask questions
* A self\-starter mindset, diligent in notetaking, multi\-tasking, and conducting research.

 **Why Join Us?**  

At Omnicom Global Solutions India, work is more than a job—it is a space to grow, thrive, and feel celebrated. We foster a culture built on integrity, respect, equity, pride, and belonging, offering a holistic employee experience that empowers real impact.

 **What Makes Life at OGS Special:**  

**Trust Through Transparency \& Integrity**: We keep things open and fair with easy access to leaders and HR, ways to share your feedback, and clear processes that ensure honesty and accountability.  

**Culture of Care \& Belonging**: We prioritize your well\-being through comprehensive insurance coverage, flexible leave options, structured onboarding, and resources for emotional and physical health. You also enjoy complimentary meals and subsidized cab services for added comfort. Beyond work, we foster togetherness through CSR initiatives, open conversations, and shared celebrations—creating a workplace where care and belonging thrive.

**Equity \& Impartiality**: We ensure fairness through benchmarked compensation, transparent performance reviews, and clear, policy\-driven decisions.  

**Recognition \& Growth**: We empower your career through sponsored learning, leadership development programs, internal mobility opportunities, and meaningful recognition—celebrating impact while enabling continuous growth.  

At OGS India, we are not just hiring for a role—we are inviting you to join a purpose\-driven, people\-first culture where your growth, well\-being, and individuality are celebrated every step of the way.

BPDA (Benefits \& Protection Data \& Analytics) is a data engineering and analytics team aligned to B\&P, structured into product\-based squads across Pune and Hyderabad. With ongoing product transformation, BPDA seeks a T8 Program Manager to provide unified leadership, stabilize delivery, and accelerate analytics\-data engineering integration. 	+ Guide analytics strategy, including BI, reporting, and embedding analytics into product squads.
	+ Evaluate and scale AI/data science use cases responsibly, ensuring business value.
	+ Provide oversight on data governance, including compliance, quality, and stewardship frameworks.

* Prior experience running cross\-functional programs.
* Track record of improving delivery reliability, throughput, and team effectiveness.
* Important Notes:
* + Prior deep data experience is not an absolute requirement.
	+ Candidates must demonstrate **above\-average learnability** in Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI/Data Science to succeed in this role.

* Unlock strategic value.

**Description**
 Leidos is seeking an experienced and strategic HR Manager to support our growing operations in India. This role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders and employees, ensuring compliance with Indian employment legislation while driving employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, talent management, and workforce planning initiatives.
   

  

 The HR Manager will partner closely with the HR EMEAI Lead, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, International Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to deliver HR programs that support business objectives, foster a positive workplace culture, and enhance the employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 This position requires a hands\-on HR professional with strong business acumen, deep knowledge of Indian employment laws and statutory requirements, and the ability to balance strategic partnership with operational execution in a fast\-paced, global environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HR Business Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, providing proactive HR guidance and support across the employee lifecycle.
* Partner with business leaders to support workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, restructures, and talent management initiatives.
* Support the implementation of regional and global HR strategies within India, ensuring alignment with business objectives and local requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support business objectives and people outcomes.
* Coach and influence managers on leadership effectiveness, employee development, performance management, and organizational best practices.


**Employee Relations \& Workplace Culture**
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace culture aligned with Leidos values and business objectives.
* Lead and manage employee relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, and capability issues.
* Promote employee wellbeing, engagement, retention, and workplace satisfaction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, equality standards, health and safety requirements, and employee welfare programs.
* Drive initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, employee engagement, and workplace effectiveness.


**Talent Acquisition \& Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Support managers with recruitment, onboarding, development, retention, and offboarding activities.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to support hiring strategies, workforce growth initiatives, and talent pipeline planning.
* Prepare employment contracts and related employment documentation while providing guidance on terms, conditions, and employment best practices.
* Coordinate employment\-related administration, including right\-to\-work verification, visa applications, and airport pass requirements where applicable.
* Ensure a seamless and positive employee experience throughout all stages of the employment lifecycle.


**Compensation, Benefits \& Payroll**
* Support the design, implementation, and administration of compensation and reward programs, including pay structures, annual salary review cycles, employee compensation adjustments, and reward initiatives.
* Manage compensation\-related employee lifecycle activities including promotions, role changes, and organizational restructures, ensuring alignment with internal governance, compensation philosophy, and market practices.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, International Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to provide compensation insights, analytics, and recommendations that support hiring, promotions, retention strategies, workforce planning, and broader talent decisions.
* Support the administration and review of in\-country benefits programs while monitoring external market trends, competitive practices, and pay positioning to ensure continued market competitiveness.
* Coordinate monthly payroll submissions and ensure compliance with HR Shared Services processes and timelines.
* Work closely with the International Payroll Manager to ensure payroll practices comply with applicable Indian labor laws, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain strong controls over compensation and employee data integrity, ensuring governance\-ready documentation, remuneration summaries, audit support, reporting accuracy, and leadership reporting requirements.
* Support salary review processes, wage administration, performance management programs, and employee reward initiatives.


**Compliance \& HR Operations**
* Develop, implement, maintain, and communicate HR policies and procedures in compliance with Indian employment legislation and company requirements.
* Ensure HR records, training documentation, and HR systems are maintained accurately and in accordance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Monitor employee absence trends and support effective attendance management practices.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable employment laws, statutory obligations, and company policies.
* Stay current on changes to Indian labor legislation and advise leaders on compliance implications and required actions.
* Support audits, reporting requirements, and regulatory compliance activities.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Work collaboratively with regional HR teams, Centers of Excellence, Shared Services, and business leaders to deliver consistent HR solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, systems, compliance practices, and employee experience.
* Support HR projects and strategic initiatives across the EMEAI region.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience in an HR Generalist, HR Business Partner, or HR Manager capacity.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, statutory compliance requirements, payroll regulations, and HR best practices.
* Strong understanding of Indian organizational culture, workforce practices, and employment frameworks.
* Proven experience supporting multi\-state operations and ensuring compliance with both national and state\-specific labor regulations.
* Prior experience developing, revising, and implementing HR policies and procedures aligned with business objectives, organizational needs, and local labor regulations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing HR programs across employee relations, performance management, compensation, benefits, talent management, and organizational development.
* Experience supporting compensation planning, salary review cycles, employee compensation actions, and market benchmarking activities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing and partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience supporting payroll processes and working with HRIS platforms.
* Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and HR systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a regional and global HR team.


**Employment Law, Payroll \& Compliance Expertise**
**The Successful Candidate Will Possess**
- Deep understanding of Indian employment legislation and statutory compliance requirements, including:

* Code on Wages, 2019
* Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Company Description** 




 Mercom India, a subsidiary of U.S.\-based Mercom Capital Group, is a leading clean energy communications and consulting firm with expertise in renewable energy. Based in Bengaluru, Mercom India supports the Indian clean energy market through research, news, and communication services. Known for its leadership and impact, Mercom India actively helps shape India’s rapidly evolving clean energy sector. The company is dedicated to advancing sustainable and renewable energy initiatives across India.
 



  





 Mercom is seeking an experienced Human Resources Manager with a proven ability to lead HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, and organizational development. The ideal candidate will be proactive, strategic, and able to support a fast\-paced media, research and events environment
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role located in Bengaluru for a Human Resources Generalist. The HR Generalist will be responsible for overseeing daily HR operations, including the administration of HR policies, employee benefits, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement programs, and supporting various HR functions to enhance workplace culture and productivity.
 



  





**1\. HR Operations and Compliance** 



* Maintain accurate HR documentation, employee records, statutory compliance, and audit readiness.
* Ensure company policies are consistently applied across all teams.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of Indian labor laws, wage standards, and regulatory changes.



 ·       Oversee payroll coordination, leave management, and attendance systems with high accuracy.
 



**2\. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Excellence** 



* Manage complete lifecycle recruitment for open positions.
* Drive talent sourcing through job portals, ATS, LinkedIn, internal databases, employee referrals, and strategic networking.
* Conduct structured screening, competency\-based interviewing, and salary negotiations.
* Build an annual hiring roadmap aligned with business growth.
* Create standardized interview frameworks and evaluation templates to ensure fair and consistent hiring.



**3\. Employee Onboarding and Orientation** 



* Develop a structured onboarding program with clear role expectations, culture orientation, and 30\-60\-90\-365 day plans.
* Ensure new hires have seamless integration into teams and company processes.



**4\. Performance Management and Goal Setting** 



* Implement quarterly and yearly performance review cycles.
* Partner with department heads to define KPIs, OKRs, and measurable performance goals.
* Conduct coaching sessions with managers to improve evaluation quality.
* Support the development of high\-performance talent pipelines.



**5\. Learning and Development** 



* Conduct training needs analysis and implement learning programs that support skill development across editorial, research, events, and business teams.
* Organize internal workshops, leadership training, communication skills programs, and technical upskilling.
* Track training effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.



**6\. Culture Building and Employee Engagement** 



* Build a culture of trust, accountability, and openness.
* Plan structured engagement activities that support collaboration, wellness, and morale.
* Develop employee feedback systems and action plans based on insights.
* Establish mechanisms to identify early indicators of conflict, burnout, or policy deviations.



**7\. HR Policy Development and Governance** 



* Create and update HR policies, organizational handbooks, disciplinary guidelines, and workplace behavior frameworks.
* Ensure zero tolerance for any form of misconduct and maintain a safe, respectful working environment.
* Support leadership in communication of policies and organizational expectations.



**8\. Disciplinary Action and Workplace Management** 



* Handle employee relations issues, grievances, and investigations with discretion and professionalism.
* Conduct fact\-based disciplinary meetings aligned with company guidelines.
* Ensure timely resolution through structured processes and documented follow\-ups.



**9\. Strategic HR and Leadership Support** 



* Work closely with senior leadership to align HR priorities with business objectives.
* Provide data driven insights, HR metrics, and reports on hiring, retention, attrition, and performance.
* Contribute to organizational design, workforce planning, and future capability building.



**10\. Exit Management** 



* Conduct exit interviews, analyze patterns, and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure smooth offboarding, full and final settlement coordination, and knowledge transfer.



  





**Experience** 




 Minimum 2 years to 8 years of proven HR experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Knowledge and experience in core Human Resources (HR) functions, including recruitment, employee relations, and managing workplace culture.
* Proficiency in HR Management practices, with the ability to implement and oversee HR Policies effectively.
* Experience with Employee Benefits administration and a strong understanding of Benefits Administration processes.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and take proactive initiatives independently.
* MBA in HR,
 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, or equivalent
* Experience in a mid\-sized organization and familiarity with employment laws, particularly within the Indian market, is a plus.

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.



We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :



Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls



Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.



Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

  

**Your key responsibilities**  

  

**Technical Excellence**

  


* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, with the ability to assess business processes for control gaps and process inefficiencies. **Qualification**


* Graduate


**Experience**


* Fresher

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.  

  

**What we offer**  

  

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5\-meter resolution and 135\+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.  

Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18\-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full\-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI\-powered analytics.  

Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in\-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high\-frequency imagery with AI\-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
**Job Overview** 


 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated
 
**Manual QA Engineer (Fresher to 2 Years Experience)** 

 with a strong foundation in software testing concepts. This role is ideal for early\-career QA professionals who are eager to learn, take ownership of quality, and work closely with developers and product teams to ensure reliable, high\-quality web applications. You will play a key role in validating features, identifying risks early, and supporting smooth product releases.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)** 
* Understand product requirements, user flows, and business logic thoroughly.
* Design, write, review, and maintain detailed test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform manual testing including functional, regression, sanity, smoke, and exploratory testing.
* Identify, log, track, and verify bugs using JIRA with clear reproduction steps and impact analysis.
* Validate APIs using Postman (request/response validation, status codes, basic payload checks).
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement discussions, and release readiness activities.
* Ensure critical user journeys are always covered before releases.
* Collaborate closely with developers to reproduce issues and verify fixes.
* Take ownership of assigned features/modules and their overall quality.
* Support production sanity checks and post\-release verification when required.



  




**Required Skills \& Experience** 
* **Fresher or up to 2 years of experience** 

 in Manual QA / Software Testing.
* **Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E / B.Tech or equivalent)** 

 .
* Strong understanding of QA fundamentals (SDLC, STLC, test types, bug life cycle).
* Hands\-on experience or academic/project experience in writing test cases with good coverage.
* Practical experience or internship exposure to
 
**JIRA** 

 for defect tracking.
* Working knowledge of
 
**Postman** 

 for basic API testing.
* Ability to understand functional workflows and edge cases.
* Strong attention to detail with a quality\-first mindset.
* Ability to replicate bugs consistently with clear steps, environment details, and data conditions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.



  




**Good to Have** 
* Experience testing SaaS or web\-based applications (internship/project exposure acceptable).
* Basic understanding of databases, logs, or browser DevTools.
* Ability to assist developers by capturing console logs, network logs, and request/response details.
* Exposure to
 
**Cypress automation** 

 (reading or writing basic test cases).
* Basic familiarity with API automation using
 
**Jest** 

 or similar frameworks.
* Understanding of basic
 
**SQL queries** 

 for data validation.
* Experience working in
 
**Agile / Scrum** 

 teams.
* Exposure to release cycles and production support activities.
* Immediate joiner or availability within a 1\-month notice period is preferred.


**Interview Process** 
* **Round 1: QA Fundamentals \& Hands\-on (QA Lead)**




 Focus on testing basics, test case writing, bug reporting, functional understanding, and tools like JIRA and Postman.
 



* **Round 2: Practical Thinking (Engineering Manager)** 

 Evaluate real\-world testing scenarios, prioritisation, sprint understanding, and collaboration with developers.
* **Round 3: Culture \& Growth Discussion (CTO)** 

 Assess learning mindset, ownership, accountability, and long\-term growth potential.



  




**Interview Best Practices** 
* Be prepared to discuss academic projects, internships, or real testing scenarios.
* Keep examples ready for test case design and defect reporting.
* Ensure a stable internet connection for remote interview rounds.



  




**About the Company** 
* **Vision:** 

 We help e\-commerce companies in India generate more revenue through marketing automation. Our products serve leading brands and process large\-scale data with reliability and speed.
* **Culture:** 

 We value ownership, accountability, and a strong quality mindset. You’ll get hands\-on learning opportunities, mentorship, and the chance to make a visible impact early in your career.



  





*If you are an engineering graduate passionate about software quality and looking to grow as a QA professional, we’d love to hear from you.*

title: Network Engineer -L2- SDWAN-HPE
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above\-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client\-centric communication.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* A client\-first attitude, always seeking to create positive client experiences.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or equivalent work experience.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

description:
Internship Summary

As a Game Development Intern, you will work with the development team to design, develop, and optimize 2D and 3D games for PC, mobile, and web platforms. You will gain practical experience in game programming, multiplayer systems, 3D asset integration, character animation, environment creation, and gameplay mechanics.

You will work on real\-world projects such as shooting games, battle royale games, simulation games, multiplayer games, open\-world environments, and action\-based gaming systems using modern technologies including Unity, Unreal Engine, MERN Stack, Blender, and cloud\-based backend systems.

Key ResponsibilitiesGame Development

* Develop 2D and 3D games using Unity and Unreal Engine.
* Implement gameplay mechanics, controls, character movement, and physics systems.
* Work on multiplayer and battleground\-style game concepts.
* Create responsive and optimized gaming experiences.
* Develop gaming UI systems such as health bars, inventory systems, maps, and scoreboards.

Multiplayer \& Backend Integration

* Assist in developing multiplayer gaming systems.
* Work with MERN Stack for backend game services and dashboards.
* Integrate APIs, databases, authentication systems, and real\-time communication.
* Implement matchmaking, leaderboard, and player profile systems.

* Work on character animation and motion systems.
* Assist in creating realistic gaming environments and immersive experiences.

Testing \& Optimization

description:
**About Wobot**
 Wobot is building the next generation of Video Intelligence. We help enterprises transform camera feeds, POS systems, IoT devices, and operational data into actionable insights using Computer Vision, AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vision Language Models (VLMs).
   

  

 Our platform is used across restaurants, retail, logistics, manufacturing, and other industries to improve operations, safety, compliance, and customer experience. We are building products such as Insight AI, Scout AI, SmartSearch, DriveThru Analytics, and AI\-powered operational intelligence tools that bring together video, business data, and AI.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own product features and modules from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Work closely with customers, partners, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering teams to identify problems worth solving.
* Translate business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Collaborate with Design and Engineering teams to build intuitive and scalable user experiences.
* Drive product discovery through customer interviews, data analysis, competitive research, and experimentation.
* Analyze product usage, adoption, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Define and monitor product KPIs and use data to make informed product decisions.
* Partner with Engineering teams to understand technical constraints and make pragmatic trade\-offs.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, prioritization, release planning, and go\-to\-market activities.
* Work on AI\-powered products involving Computer Vision, LLMs, AI Agents, Search, Analytics, and Automation workflows.
* Collaborate across multiple stakeholders while maintaining a strong focus on customer value and business outcomes.


**What We're Looking For**
* 2â3 years of Product Management experience in SaaS, B2B software, analytics, AI, or technology products.
* Strong problem\-solving and structured thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into actionable solutions.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions.
* Comfort working directly with Engineering teams and understanding technical trade\-offs.
* Experience writing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Hands\-on attitude with a willingness to dive into customer calls, product testing, data analysis, process design, and UI reviews when required.
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging technologies.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in B2B SaaS startups.
* Technical background in Engineering, Computer Science, or related disciplines.
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, system integrations, and software architecture concepts.
* Experience with analytics and product tools such as Mixpanel, Segment, Amplitude, Google Analytics, Metabase, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, LLMs, Agentic AI, or Data products.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


**How We Work**
* We use Microsoft Teams for daily communication, including standups and team meetings.
* Our culture values open discussion, ownership, and a founder's mindset.
* We prioritize exceptional design, UI/UX, thorough documentation, clear to\-do lists, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Team bonding is encouraged through bi\-monthly townhalls, destressing sessions with a certified healer, and biannual company retreats.

 Python Engineer (0–2 Yrs)
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 Efficienza is looking for a Python Engineer to join a fast\-moving team building backend services, APIs, and data\-driven applications. This role is ideal for candidates with strong Python fundamentals and an interest in backend development, whether gained through internships, academic projects, or self\-driven learning. You will contribute to backend systems and data workflows that support both internal and client\-facing products. We value engineers who take initiative, learn independently, ask thoughtful questions, and enjoy solving real\-world technical problems.
   

  

**You Will Excel If You**
* Write clean, readable Python code and maintain code standards as systems grow
* Understand how APIs, databases, and services work together before implementation phase.
* Use documentation, logs, and available resources to investigate problems and learn independently
* Take ownership of assigned work, communicate blockers early, and follow through reliably
* Stay curious about backend systems, APIs, data flows, and how real\-world applications are built and scaled


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Python Development and Code Quality
   

  

* Write clean, well\-structured Python code following agreed conventions across functions, modules, and packages
* Break down assigned features into logical components with clear input, output, and error handling before implementation
* Use object\-oriented programming concepts such as classes, inheritance, composition, and abstraction to build scalable backend applications
* Apply Python fundamentals correctly: data structures, comprehensions, generators, context managers, and exception handling
* Write code that is modular, reusable, and easy to extend as requirements evolve
* Write basic unit tests for functions and modules using pytest to validate behaviour and catch regressions early


 Backend Services and API Development
   

  

* Build and maintain RESTful API endpoints using FastAPI or Flask, following consistent naming and response conventions
* Implement request validation, error handling, and structured response formatting across all endpoints
* Work with relational databases: write queries, manage schema changes, and validate data integrity
* Integrate with internal and third\-party APIs, handling authentication, request validation, error responses, and service interactions
* Work with external services and APIs, understand how they communicate, and troubleshoot integration issues when they arise


 Database and Storage
   

  

* Write and optimize SQL queries for PostgreSQL across read, write, and aggregation use cases
* Understand database schema design at a basic level: normalization, foreign keys, indexes, and the tradeoffs involved
* Validate that data flows correctly between APIs, business logic, and storage layers
* Work on caching and session storage by understanding basic data structures
* Assist in maintaining database migrations and understand their impact on existing data and services


 Initiative and Independent Work
   

  

* Take ownership of assigned tasks from implementation through testing and review
* Raise ambiguities, dependencies, and blockers early instead of waiting until deadlines
* Propose implementation approaches and seek feedback when requirements are unclear


 Collaboration and Communication
   

  

* Collaborate with engineers during sprint activities and communicate progress, blockers, and dependencies clearly
* Learn from code reviews and architectural guidance, applying established engineering standards consistently
* Contribute to documentation and seek feedback early to ensure implementations align with team practices and expectations


 Required Technical Knowledge
   

  

 Area Details
 **Python** 
 Data structures, OOPS, error handling
 **REST API Basics** 
 HTTP methods, status codes, request/response structure, JSON handling
 **FastAPI or Flask** 
 Routing, request validation, response models, basic middleware
 **SQL / PostgreSQL** 
 SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, JOIN, WHERE clauses, basic schema understanding

 Key\-value storage concepts, caching basics, expiry handling

 Ability to build and run standalone Python scripts

 Commits, branches, pull requests, resolving conflicts, clean history, CI/CD Pipeline
   

  

 Key Deliverables
   

  

* Build and maintain Python services, APIs, and data workflows with appropriate testing and documentation

* Contribute to reliable sprint delivery by completing tasks on time and communicating risks or blockers early


 Good to Have

* Exposure to Docker, async Python, data processing libraries, or message queue concepts
* Open\-source contributions or publicly accessible projects that demonstrate practical development experience

 At Sandvik, we offer you a world of opportunities. Our diverse businesses and global network enable you to explore your potential and thrive.  Sandvik Mining \& Rock Solutions (SMR) is a leading supplier in equipment and tools, services and technical solutions for the mining and construction industries. To our Rock Tools division and to our Human Resources department at Patancheru plant (Hyderabad), we are now looking for a Manager \- HR to join us
   

  

**Your Scope:**
 The role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end Human Resources and Industrial Relations agenda at the Plant, ensuring harmonious employee relations, statutory compliance, and capability development in alignment with business objectives. The incumbent will play a key role in strengthening industrial harmony, enhancing workforce productivity, and support organizational transformation through digitalization and talent initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 The incumbent will lead discipline management and industrial relations at the Plant, ensuring fair, transparent, and consistent handling of disciplinary matters, domestic enquiries, and grievance resolution. The role requires maintaining constructive union relations through continuous engagement, negotiations, and proactive conflict prevention, while aligning with long\-term business interests.
   

  

 The position will drive contract labour (CL) strategy including planning, optimization, and compliance of flexible manpower to ensure cost efficiency and operational agility. It will also oversee implementation of new labour codes and ensure adherence to all statutory requirements, liaising with government authorities and managing inspections, audits, and legal matters effectively.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role includes driving structured communication across shopfloor and staff, ensuring clarity, transparency, and engagement. The role will act as a bridge between management and employees, strengthening industrial connect and fostering a positive work culture.
   

  

 The incumbent will lead HR digitalization initiatives to improve efficiency, data\-driven decision making, and employee experience. This includes adoption and governance of HR systems and tools supporting workforce management.
   

  

 Capability building for shopfloor employees is a critical focus area, with ownership of programs and other structured learning interventions aimed at enhancing skills, productivity, and career progression.
   

  

 In addition, the role will drive talent management practices including performance management, succession planning, and development interventions to build a strong internal talent pipeline.
   

  

 The position will also support corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives and strengthen the organization’s connect with the external ecosystem including local communities and industry bodies.
   

  

**Your Profile:**
* Postgraduate in Human Resources / Industrial Relations with 12 years significant experience in manufacturing setup, preferably with exposure to unionized environments and plant HR operations.

title: AI Generalist
description:
Scouto is redefining recruitment with an autonomous AI recruiter that can source, outreach, video screen, rank, and schedule candidates — all without human intervention.
   

  

 Our goal is simple: make hiring instant, effortless, and AI\-powered.
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **AI Generalist** 
 who can work across client operations, recruiting workflows, automation, product coordination, and customer success. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who is deeply AI\-native, operationally sharp, and excited to build systems rather than just manage tasks.
   

  

 You will act as the bridge between clients, hiring managers, Scouto’s AI recruiter, and our internal product and engineering teams. You should be comfortable wearing multiple hats, moving fast, coordinating with stakeholders, and using AI tools every day to make work faster, smarter, and more scalable.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Understand hiring requirements from clients and translate them into clear AI\-powered hiring campaigns.
* Set up, manage, and optimize hiring workflows inside Scouto’s AI recruiting platform.
* Coordinate closely with founders, hiring managers, and client\-side stakeholders to ensure hiring campaigns are running smoothly.
* Review AI\-generated candidate pipelines, identify the most relevant profiles, and share curated recommendations with clients.
* Monitor campaign performance and suggest improvements to sourcing, outreach, screening, and candidate ranking.
* Use AI tools to improve day\-to\-day operations, including documentation, reporting, communication, workflow creation, and process automation.
* Build lightweight automations, templates, prompts, SOPs, and internal workflows that reduce manual effort.
* Act as the first line of coordination between clients and Scouto’s AI recruiter.
* Work with product and engineering teams to communicate client feedback, troubleshoot issues, and suggest product improvements.
* Help improve Scouto’s internal operating systems as we scale.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

* 1\+ years of experience in one of the following operations, recruiting, customer success, account management, founder’s office, business operations, or a similar generalist role.
* Strong experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Perplexity, Notion AI, Zapier, Make, or similar products.
* You are genuinely AI\-native — you don’t just “use ChatGPT sometimes”; you actively look for ways to automate, simplify, and improve work using AI.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders, including founders, hiring managers, candidates, clients, and internal teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast\-changing priorities.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break messy tasks into repeatable workflows.
* Curious about AI, automation, recruiting, SaaS, and startup operations.
* Excited to work in a fast\-moving startup where the role will evolve quickly.


 You’ll be a great fit if
   

  

* When you see a repetitive task, your first instinct is to automate it.
* You enjoy working across product, operations, customers, and hiring.
* You are comfortable figuring things out without waiting for detailed instructions.
* You can talk to clients clearly, but also go deep into workflows and systems.
* You like building processes from scratch.
* You are excited by the idea of working with an AI recruiter every day and making it better.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Prior experience in recruitment, staffing, HR tech, SaaS, or customer operations.
* Experience using workflow automation tools like Zapier, Make, Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, or CRM systems.
* Experience writing prompts, creating SOPs, building dashboards, or automating internal processes.
* Comfort with basic no\-code or low\-code tools.
* Exposure to product operations, implementation, or customer success in a startup.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




  





 We are theprintspace \- a fine art printing and dropshipping company with a small but genuinely global team. We have around 65 people across London, Düsseldorf, New York, and India, and we combine technology with craftsmanship to support artists, photographers, and creatives in sharing their work with the world. You can learn more about what we do at theprintspace.com and theprintspace.co.uk.
 



 We are a growing company, which means we are still figuring things out in many areas. We try to be honest about that. What we do know is that we care about our people, and we want to build an HR function that reflects that.
 



  





**Why we are hiring** 




 We are looking for an HR Manager to take ownership of our people operations across all four of our locations. This is a standalone role, and the person who joins us will be an important part of how we grow and look after our team. We are not expecting perfection \- we are expecting someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in making things work better for the people around them.
 



  





**What the role involves** 




 Day to day, you would be the main person our team turns to for anything people\-related. That includes:
 


* Managing onboarding and offboarding across all our locations, so that joining and leaving the company is a smooth experience for everyone
* Coordinating payroll with our regional providers in the UK, Germany, US, and India \- making sure everything is accurate and people are paid on time
* Keeping us compliant with employment laws across our regions, which we know is no small thing
* Running our recruitment process from start to finish \- writing job descriptions, shortlisting candidates, organising interviews, and supporting hiring managers along the way
* Being the first point of contact for employee questions and concerns, and handling them with care and discretion
* Supporting our managers in running structured performance and probationary reviews
* Helping us build and maintain the processes and documentation that keep a distributed team connected and well\-organised



  





**What we are looking for** 




**We would love to hear from you if you have:** 



* Around 5\+ years of HR experience, ideally including time in a generalist or standalone HR role
* Some familiarity with employment law or HR practice in at least one or two of our regions — UK, Germany, US, or India
* Experience working with payroll providers or coordinating payroll across locations
* Confidence running end\-to\-end recruitment, even in a busy environment
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several things at once without things slipping
* A degree of comfort working remotely and across time zones



 We do not expect you to have everything on this list. If you feel you have the right foundation and the right attitude, we would still like to hear from you.
 



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 




 This role will suit someone who:
 


* Is comfortable being the only HR person in the room — you enjoy the variety, and you do not need a large team around you to do good work
* Likes building things from scratch — whether that is a process, a policy, or a way of doing something that did not exist before
* Handles sensitive situations with maturity and calm, even when things are complicated or uncertain
* Communicates clearly and honestly — with employees, managers, and external providers alike
* Takes initiative without waiting to be told, but also knows when to ask for input
* Cares about doing the right thing for people, not just following procedure



 If you have worked in a small or growing company before and found it energising rather than stressful, you will likely feel at home here.
 



  





**What you'll get** 



* A fully remote role with genuine flexibility in how and where you work
* The opportunity to shape the HR function of a growing global company — this is not a role where things are already decided for you
* A close\-knit, communicative team that uses Slack throughout the day and video calls often — remote, but never isolated
* The chance to work across four countries and build experience in multi\-jurisdictional HR that is genuinely rare at this level
* A company that is honest about where it is in its journey, and values people who want to grow alongside it
* Competitive salary, discussed openly during the process



  





**How we work** 




 Our team is fully remote but very connected. We use Slack throughout the day and jump on video calls often — it genuinely does not feel like a remote job most of the time. We try to communicate openly, support each other, and give people the space to do their best work.
 



 We are growing, and we want someone who will grow with us. If you are looking for somewhere to bring your experience, learn new things, and genuinely contribute to how a company looks after its people, we think this could be a good fit.
 



  





**To apply:** 



* Email hannah.owen@theprintspace.com with your CV, current CTC (in lakhs), notice period/immediate start, and a 3 minute short video that answers the following:
* In your own words, walk us through a difficult people situation you handled on your own — what made it hard, how you approached it, and what you'd do differently now — and tell us why you think handling moments like that well matters for a small, distributed team like theprintspace.
